summary: Google OAuth2 on upgrade: SOCIAL_AUTH_GOOGLE_OAUTH2_KEY, SECRET and SCOPE become the authenticator's KEY, SECRET, REDIRECT_STATE and SCOPE configuration, and the organization and team maps become organization and team authenticator maps (Organization Member, Team Member); also introduces the MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH setting.
questions: How is Google OAuth2 migrated to AAP 2.6?
How do I map Google users to a team in the platform gateway?
